name: Squads
text: Squads in Into The Breach determine the Mechs you can take with you onto the battlefield. You start with the Rift Walkers squad. Additional squads are unlocked by completing Achievements. Each completed achivement earns 1 coin. Each squad has a custom paint job. Unlocked mech colors can be applied to other squads. Random Squads and Custom Squads: Once a second squad is acquired, the option to create a randomized squad or a customized squad opens up. A Custom Squad allows for the selection of any Mechs that have been unlocked, including multiple of the same class as well as multiple of the same Mech. A Random Squad is created out of all the unlocked Mechs. * The Balanced Roll option selects three unique Mechs from three of the five different classes (Prime, Brute, Ranged, Science, and Cyborg). The balanced squad won't have more than 4 weapons so this prevents the Flame Mech, Rocket Mech, Defense Mech, Gravity Mech, Nano Mech, Smog Mech, and Napalm Mech from appearing together in a balanced squad. * The Chaos Roll option has no restrictions on class, weaponry, or Mech combinations so you get a truly random squad. However, if you get duplicate Mechs with the same Passive ability, one of the duplicate Mechs will have the Passive and any power associated with it removed. name: Vek
text: The Vek are the main enemies encountered in Into The Breach. Gameplay: The main goal of Into the Breach is to make sure that the Vek do not destroy all of the grid power. Each island has a set variety of Vek that can spawn, one of which is a Psion, a supporting unit that grants a passive bonus to others. They emerge from the ground on certain tiles, which can be intercepted at the cost of 1 health during the enemy turn. Before the player turn any active Vek will move to a certain tile and prepare to attack it, aiming for either a mech, building or objective. These attacks are executed during the enemy turn unless they are cancelled or the Vek is killed beforehand. Vek are divided into five main groups: *Common Vek are those that can spawn on any island and make up most of the spawns on a mission. All of them have a soft limit on spawns per mission that can be bypassed if the spawning algorithm needs to. * Rare Vek are those whose attacks are more unique than common ones and do not appear on early islands. *Psions, which provide passive bonuses to other Vek when spawned. Note that the Psion itself does not benefit from the passive bonus. *Minor Vek, which are spawned by other Vek, are typically very weak, and bypass the spawning algorithm. They are not worth any experience and are not affected by Psion bonuses. *Hive Leaders, bosses found on the final mission of each island, the Volcanic Hive and normal missions on the fourth island in Unfair difficulty. name: Time Pod
text: The Time Pod is a special item in Into The Breach that can randomly drop during missions. Description: During each Mission, there is a chance for a pod to appear from the future, dropping it onto a random tile. This can happen in any Mission except for ones with the Protect the Corporate Tower objective. A new objective is added when this event happens: Protect the Time Pod. The 1st and 2nd islands in a timeline will always have one Time Pod. The 3rd and 4th island will always have two Time Pods. Note that this number also includes the appearance of a Strange Pod, which has a 15% chance of replacing a Time Pod in the 2nd, 3rd or 4th island. Protecting or rescuing the Pod always grants a Reactor Core. Time Pods may also contain a Pilot, a Weapon, or a piece of Passive equipment. If the Vek end on the tile where the Pod is, or if it takes damage from a Mech or a Vek attack, the Pod will be destroyed. Projectile weapons can pass safely over the pod, but not piercing/beam weapons. A Pod is still destroyed if the Vek who steps on it has Flying. If the Pod remains untouched until the end of the mission, it is recovered as well. Media:

name: Grid Power
text: Grid Power is reduced when Civilian Buildings are damaged. When it reaches zero, the player loses and the current run ends. The Power Grid indicator shows how much Grid Power remains. The player begins the game with 5 Grid Power and may have up to 7. If Grid Power would be increased beyond 7, Grid Defense increases instead. Increases and decreases to Grid Power persist between Islands. Gaining Grid Power: Grid Power can be regained by the following means: * Some missions grant Grid Power as a Resource reward for completing bonus objective(s). * *After finishing a Corporate Island, the player can buy 1 Grid Power for every 1 Corporate Reputation point spent. * *When completing a Perfect Island, the player can choose +2 Grid Power as their reward. * *The Grid Charger weapon, if found, restores 1 Grid Power when used successfully. (* On Unfair difficulty, this gain is doubled.) Grid Defense: Grid Defense is the percentage chance that a building tile will resist damage. Grid Defense starts at 15%. (On Unfair difficulty, Grid Defense starts at 0% but can still be increased.) Grid Defense can be increased by the following means: * Overpower Bonus. Each point of Grid Power obtained when the Power Grid is full increases Grid Defense by 2% (the first 5 times), then by 1%, up to a maximum of +25%. *Pilot Bonus. name: Corporate Reputation
text: Corporate Reputation is one of the Resources in Into the Breach. Corporate Reputation Points are earned for successfully completing objectives during Missions. The Corporate Store becomes available after fighting the Hive Leader of an island. Corporate Reputation Points cannot be carried over to another island. Grid Power can be purchased for 1 Corporate Reputation each to repair the Power Grid or to Overpower Grid Defense. Weapons can be donated for 1 Corporate Reputation. Pilots can be donated for 1 Corporate Reputation, unless they have Popular Hero, in which case they will be donated for 4 instead.

name: Missions
text: Missions are issued within each island you defend with your squads. Each mission has specific objectives, such as protecting or destroying certain units and buildings. Details: Missions are determined by the number of bonus objectives that can be fulfilled for either Corporate Reputation , Grid Power or Reactor Cores . A mission has at least one bonus objective and a maximum of three excluding newly-generated ones from a time pod. The number of objectives determines a sector's difficulty: * 1 objective: Defensive shields are placed on random buildings. These missions only have one objective, that gives out one power or reputation. * 2 objectives: No modifier applied. These missions either have two objectives, with each giving out one power, reputation or Reactor Core, or one objective that gives out two power or reputation. * 3 objectives: High-threat detected, meaning at least one alpha Vek and increased spawns. These missions can have up to three objectives, with the total rewards adding up to 3 of either Reactor Cores, power, or reputation. Usually a building that rewards a Reactor Core will be present. Time Pods can randomly appear in missions and require the player to protect it until the end of the mission or collect it using a mech or allied unit. They always reward a Reactor Core and have a chance of giving a weapon, passive or pilot. Upon landing a new objective called Protect the Time Pod will appear, which "rewards" the pod. The stronger variant of the regular Hornet with more health, damage and range. Flying mobility lets it move freely through mountains, cities and the players units. It cannot be drowned, so has to be killed through damage and damaging effects instead.

name: Hornet Leader
text: Health 6, move 3. Weapons/skills: Super Stinger: Stab three tiles in a row for 2 damage each.. Special: Flying: Flying units can move over any terrain tile.. A giant wasp that moves through the air to attack with its stinger.

name: Blast Psion
text: Health 2, move 2. Weapons/skills: Explosive Decay: All other Vek will explode on death, dealing 1 damage to adjacent tiles.. Special: Flying: Flying units can move over any terrain tile.. The jellyfish-like Psions act as support units, providing passive bonuses to the Vek. The Blast Psion is distinguished by its light grey coloration and bright orange cranial nodes. This Psion's presence causes other Vek to explode upon death, damaging adjacent tiles. The ability granted to the other Vek is called Explosive Decay. The Blast Psion can never spawn on missions with explosive mines, even if they are the Psion for the Archive, Inc. island.

name: Psion Tyrant
text: Health 2, move 2. Weapons/skills: Hive Targeting: All player units take 1 damage at the end of every turn.. Special: Flying: Flying units can move over any terrain tile.. The Psion Tyrant does not buff Vek and instead damages all player-controlled units every turn, including the Renfield Bomb and deployable tanks. It has a primarily orange body with dark purple bumps adorning its head. Psion Tyrants only spawn on the Volcanic Hive and are capped at one spawn per "phase" of the final mission. Under the Psionic Receiver, the Psion Tyrant also inflicts 1 damage to all Vek, the Tyrant itself included.

name: Psion Abomination
text: Health 5, move 3. Weapons/skills: Overpowered: All other Vek gain +1 HP, Regeneration, and explode on death.. Special: Flying: Flying units can move over any terrain tile.. The Psion Abomination does not attack but instead grants all other Vek "overpowered", combining the effects of the Soldier Psion, Blood Psion and Blast Psion. No other Psions can spawn if the mission contains a Psion Abomination. It will never replace the 4th island's Psion enemy during Unfair difficulty (unless it is the leader of the island for the HQ mission), nor replace the Psion Tyrant during the Volcanic Hive.

name: Spider
text: Health 2, move 2. Weapons/skills: Tiny Offspring: Throw a sticky egg that hatches into a Spiderling.. Spiders have very limited movement, but have the unique ability of throwing a Spiderling Egg on any column or row they are aligned with. This egg traps all surrounding entities in webs upon landing and will hatch into a Spiderling on the next turn. As a rare Vek, Spiders cannot spawn on the first island, and are limited to one spawn per mission (including its alpha).

name: Alpha Spider
text: Health 4, move 2. Weapons/skills: Large Offspring: Throw a sticky egg that hatches into a Spiderling.. Alpha Spiders have very limited movement, but have the unique ability of throwing a Spiderling Egg on any column or row they are aligned with. This egg traps all surrounding entities in webs upon landing and will hatch into a Spiderling on the next turn. The Spiderling's stats from the Alpha Spider are identical to that of the regular Spiders. As a rare Vek, Alpha Spiders cannot spawn on the first island are are limited to one spawn per mission.

name: Spider Leader
text: Health 6, move 2. Weapons/skills: Plentiful Offspring: Throw out 2-3 Spiderling eggs.. Special: Massive: Massive units can walk in Water (but Water will prevent attacking or repairing).. The Spider Leader starts with two spiderling eggs that hatch before the player turn. Each time the spider leader moves, it will throw two spiderling eggs onto random locations around the map. Unlike normal spiders these eggs do not immobilise adjacent units. Unlike all other leaders Spider Leaders can only appear in the boss mission of an island. On Unfair difficulty, they cannot appear on regular missions in the fourth island.

name: Spiderling Egg
text: Health 1, move 0. Weapons/skills: Spiderling Egg: Hatch into Spiderling.. Special: Smoke Immunity: This unit is unaffected by Smoke.. The Spiderling Eggs are spawned directly by Spiders, Alpha Spiders, and Spider Leaders; and spawned indirectly by Arachnid Psions, which cause other Vek to spawn eggs upon death. The eggs spawned by Spiders and Alpha Spiders appear larger and web adjacent targets upon being created. The egg will, on it's turn, kill itself and spawn a Spiderling

name: Spiderling
text: Health 1, move 3. Weapons/skills: Tiny Mandibles: Weak 1 damage attack against a single adjacent target.. Spiderlings, spawned from Spiderling Eggs, are a very weak 1-health, 1-damage enemy that can quickly overwhelm the player with numbers.

When emerging they attack a 3-tile wide area in front of them perpendicular to where they are facing. Upon taking any damage, they will cancel their attack and retreat underground, re-emerging elsewhere (within 4 tiles of where they retreated from) on their next turn. Burrowers can not end their move on top of Ice Tiles. Burrowers are Stable and thus cannot be pushed or moved with physical force, however they can still be relocated by the Control Mech's Control Shot weapon.

Much like the Hornet, Mosquitoes are 2-health flying Vek that have a weak melee attack. Unlike the Hornet, however, Mosquitoes have one less point of movement and apply Smoke to the targeted tile at the end of their movement. Mosquitoes cannot spawn on an island with any other flying Vek (Hornet, Moth) other than the island's Psion.

As a flying enemy with 4 health, the Mosquito is similar to the Alpha Hornet, trading 1 point of movement and the ability to attack 2 tiles for the ability to apply Smoke to the target tile and damage for three points. Mosquitoes and their alpha variant cannot spawn on an island with any other flying Vek (Hornet, Moth) other than the island's Psion.

The Moth is a 3-health, 3-move flying Vek that fires an artillery attack much like the Scarab, flying over any tiles to land on the target and deal 1 point of damage. This attack pushes the affected target and the Moth itself away by one tile. Moths cannot spawn on an island with any other flying Vek (Hornet, Mosquito) other than the island's Psion. In addition, they also cannot spawn with either Scarabs or Crabs.

name: Starfish
text: Health 2, move 3. Weapons/skills: Brittle Appendages: Deal 1 damage to four oblique tiles.. Starfish attack by striking the four corner tiles around them, much like a grounded 4-way Hornet. Despite being based off an aquatic creature they are capable of drowning. As a rare Vek, Starfish cannot spawn on the first island are are limited to two spawns per mission.

name: Plasmodia
text: Health 3, move 2. Weapons/skills: Splitting Spores: Launch a short-lived Spore.. Much like the Blobber and Spider, the Plasmodia is a slow-moving spawner Vek that fires a Spore using artillery range. The Spore destroys itself during the enemy turn to shoot a pushing projectile for 1 damage at a certain direction. As a rare Vek, Plasmodia cannot spawn on the first island and are limited to only one spawn per mission. Plasmodia also cannot spawn with either Blobbers, Spiders, the Blobber Leader, Spider Leader or Plasmodia Leader.

text: Health 3, move 3. Weapons/skills: Explosive Prize: Create an explosive boulder, preparing to destroy it next turn by attacking it for 1 damage.. These boulders do not explode if they are not damaged. If a Tumblebug is forced to attack a mech directly it will not summon an unstable boulder. As a rare Vek, Tumblebugs cannot appear on the first island and are restricted to two spawns per mission, including its alpha. They cannot spawn on missions with explosive mines.

If the hook does not hit anything the Gastropod does not move. Despite being based off an aquatic animal they are able to drown.

text: Health 5, move 2. Weapons/skills: Eruptive Growths: Throw a sticky blob that will explode.. Special: Massive: Massive units can walk in Water (but Water will prevent attacking or repairing).. Blob Leaders have two points of health and explode during the enemy turn to damage itself by 1 and adjacent tiles by 2, meaning that they will detonate twice before they naturally die. Blobber Leaders prevent the spawning of both normal and alpha variants of the Blobber, Spider and Plasmodia. The Spiderling Egg matches those that spawn from the Spider Leader and does not web surrounding tiles. These eggs spawn even if the vek falls into water or a bottomless pit, with the egg flying out of the body of water or hole and landing on a nearby land tile. Psions can only spawn once per mission. Psions can only spawn once per mission. The Psionic Receiver boosts all mechs when a Raging Psion is present.

name: A.C.I.D. Tank
text: Deploy a Tank that can apply A.C.I.D. to targets. Single-use. The A.C.I.D. Tank starts with 1 HP and 3 move points. Class: Any. Upgrades: * +2 Health (1 Reactor Core ) - Increases the Tank's max health to 3. * Push (1 Reactor Core ) - The Tank's attack also pushes its target. Availability: Upgrade: +2 Health (cost 1); Upgrade: Push (cost 1).

name: Corroding A.C.I.D.
text: Weapon damage against this unit is doubled. All other damage (Push, Blocking, Fire, etc.) is unaffected. Weapon damage against this unit is doubled. All other damage (Push, Blocking, Fire, etc.) is unaffected. Corroding A.C.I.D. can be inflicted on units through specific weapons, such as the A.C.I.D. Projector. It can also be present in the environment, on missions located in the Detritus Disposal island. Corroding A.C.I.D. will also disable Armor until the unit Repairs. A.C.I.D. applies to self-damage from weapons like Unstable Cannon, and doubles the increased damage taken resulting from a Booste

name: Heat Engines
text: Standing on Fire removes Fire and gives the Mech a "Boost". Class: Any. Upgrades: Heat Engines has no upgrades. Availability:

name: Networked Shielding
text: Mechs cannot take damage during the Player Turn. Costs 2 Reactor Cores to power. Class: Any. Upgrades: Networked Armor has no upgrades. Availability:

name: Quick-Fire Rockets
text: Fire two projectiles in different directions. Starts with 1 damage to each target. Class: Brute. Upgrades: * Add Push - Will now push both targets. * +1 Damage - +1 damage to both targets. Availability: Damage 1. Upgrade: Add Push (cost 1); Upgrade: +1 Damage (cost 3).

name: Firestorm Generator
text: Flaming artillery that drops fire on the way to its target. Burns all targets in its range. Pushes the final target away. Starts with 2-tile range. Class: Science. Upgrades: * +1 Range (1 Reactor Core ) - Maximum range is increased by 1. * +2 Range (2 Reactor Cores ) - Maximum range is increased by 2. Availability: Upgrade: +1 Rnage (cost 1); Upgrade: +2 Rnage (cost 2).

name: Flood Drill
text: Convert any liquid Tile (e.g. Water, Lava) to a Hole, spreading the liquid to adjacent tiles. Single-use. Costs 1 Reactor Core to power. Class: Any. Upgrades: * +1 Use - Increases uses per battle by 1. Availability: Upgrade: +1 Use (cost 1).

name: Void Shocker
text: If a Vek deals no damage to buildings or units when attacking, it takes 1 damage. Costs 2 Reactor Cores to power. Vek attacks that damage mountains or take down shields will still activate Void Shocker. The damage from Void Shocker is not affected by A.C.I.D. nor armor. Class: Any. Upgrades: Void Shocker has no upgrades. Availability:

name: Smoldering Shells
text: Damage and apply Fire to a tile while adding Smoke to adjacent tiles. Deals 1 damage to the target that is lit on Fire. Smoke is spread to the side tiles, perpendicularly from the users line of fire. Class: Ranged. Upgrades: * More Smoke (2 Reactor Cores ) - Adds Smoke to more tiles (all surrounding tiles are now covered in Smoke) * +2 Damage (3 Reactor Cores ) - Increases the center tile damage b Damage 1. Upgrade: More Smoke (cost 2); Upgrade: +2 Damage (cost 3).

name: Reverse Thrusters
text: Smoke and deal damage to a tile while dashing away. Damage is based on distance travelled. Deals 1 Self-Damage to the user. Starts with 2-tile range. Class: Brute. Upgrades: * +1 Range * +1 Range Availability: Damage 1-2 (1 self). Upgrade: +1 Range (cost 1); Upgrade: +1 Range (cost 3).

name: EM Railgun
text: Pierce through any killed Enemies. Single-use. Deals 2 damage to the target, and continues to travel through any killed targets. Class: Brute. Upgrades: * +2 Damage - Deals 2 additional damage to all targets. * Building Immune - This attack will no longer damage Grid Buildings. Availability: Damage 2. Upgrade: +2 Damage (cost 1); Upgrade: Building Immune (cost 1).

name: Ricochet Rocket
text: Bounce a projectile off one target to hit another. Deals 1 damage and pushes each target. Class: Brute. Upgrades: * +1 Damage * Ally Immune - Friendly units will not take damage from this attack. Availability: Damage 1. Upgrade: +1 Damage (cost 3); Upgrade: Ally Immune (cost 1).

name: Guided Missile
text: A projectile that can turn once before hitting its target. Deals 2 damage to the target and pushes. Class: Brute. Upgrades: * +1 Damage * Smoke Line - After turning, adds Smoke to each tile passed through. Availability: Damage 2. Upgrade: +1 Damage (cost 3); Upgrade: Smoke Line (cost 1).

name: AP Cannon
text: Fire a pushing projectile that pierces the first target, and damages the second. The first target is only pushed with no direct damage. The second target is dealt 2 damage and gets pushed. Class: Brute. Upgrades: * +1 Damage * +1 Damage Availability: Damage 2. Upgrade: +1 Damage (cost 2); Upgrade: +1 Damage (cost 2).

name: Fracturing Shells
text: Fires a projectile that explodes on contact, damaging and pushing adjacent tiles. Deals 1 damage to 3 adjacent tiles. Class: Brute. Upgrades: * +2 Damage * Buildings Immune Availability: Damage 1. Upgrade: +2 Damage (cost 3); Upgrade: Buildings Immune (cost 1).

name: Tri-Rocket
text: Damage and push 3 tiles in a line. Deals 1 damage to each target and pushes them away. Can aim at close tile. Class: Ranged. Upgrades: * +1 Damage (3 Reactor Cores ) - Deals 1 additional damage to all targets. * Building Immune (2 Reactor Cores ) - This attack will no longer damage Grid Buildings. Availability: Damage 1. Upgrade: +1 Damage (cost 3); Upgrade: Building Immune (cost 1).

name: Bomb Dispenser
text: Launch a Walking Bomb. Unused bombs dismantle after the enemy turn. Class: Ranged. Upgrades: * 2 Bombs (3 Reactor Cores ) - Fire a second Walking Bomb in a different direction. Availability: Upgrade: 2 Bombs (cost 3).

name: Arachnoid Injector
text: Damage target, creating a friendly robot spider on kill. Artillery attack starts at 1 damage. Class: Ranged. Upgrades: * +1 Damage - Increases the artillery attack damage by 1. * Acidic - Adds A.C.I.D. to the attack of the Arachnoid. Availability: Damage 1. Upgrade: +1 Damage (cost 2); Upgrade: Acidic (cost 1).

name: Shield Placer
text: Shield target and push adjacent tiles away. Class: Science. Upgrades: * +1 Range (1 Reactor Core ) - Can target one additional tile away. * +2 Range* (2 Reactor Core ) - Can target two* additional tiles away. * Note; in game description is incorrect for the 2nd upgrade; it's actually +2 range. Availability: Upgrade: +1 Range (cost 1); Upgrade: +2 Range* (cost 2).

name: Explosive Warp
text: Teleport to target and push nearby tiles away. Starts with 2 tile range. Target tile must not be occupied by another unit. Class: Science. Upgrades: * +2 Range (1 Reactor Core ) - Maximum range is increased by 2. * +2 Range (1 Reactor Core ) - Maximum range is increased by 2. Availability: Upgrade: +2 Range (cost 1); Upgrade: +2 Range (cost 1).

name: Area Shift
text: Push self and all adjacent tiles. Class: Science. Upgrades: * Shield Self (1 Reactor Core ) - Shield the user when activated. * Shield Ally (2 Reactor Cores ) - Shield any Ally units affected by this skill. Availability: Upgrade: Shield Self (cost 1); Upgrade: Shield Ally (cost 2).

name: Grid Assault
text: Overload the grid causing a building to damage and push an adjacent tile. Deals 1 damage to one tile next to any Civilian Building or Power Pilon in the map. The building is chosen first, then the adjacent tile to damage and push. Class: Any. Upgrades: * +1 Damage - Increases damage by 1. * +1 Damage - Increases damage by 1. Availability: Damage 1. Upgrade: +1 Damage (cost 1); Upgrade: +1 Damage (cost 1).

name: Grid Repulse
text: Overload the grid causing a building to push away nearby units. Any Civilian Building or Power Pilon in the map can be chosen by the Mech to push away all nearby units. Class: Any. Upgrades: * Add Shield - The selected building also gains a shield. Availability: Upgrade: Add Shield (cost 1).

name: Smoke Tile
text: Most units cannot attack in Smoke. Units in Smoke cannot attack or repair. A Sand Tile that is hit by weapon damage will turn into a Smoke Tile. Some weapons and enemy attacks are capable of creating their own Smoke Tiles as well. Units under Smoke will be denoted with the Smoke status, and will clear if the unit moves out of Smoke. If a unit is on Fire when it moves into a Smoke Tile, the fire will be put out. On the other hand, if a Smoke Tile is hit by an attack that does fire damage, the Smoke will be replaced by a Fire Tile.

name: Fire Tile
text: Lights units on Fire.

name: Spawn Tile
text: Vek will emerge here next turn. Any unit blocking this space will take one damage. Vek will emerge here next turn. Any unit blocking this space will take one damage.

name: Air Strike
text: Bombs will be dropped here, instantly killing any unit

name: Emerging
text: Vek will emerge here next turn. Any unit blocking this space will take one damage.

name: Falling Rock
text: A rock will fall here, killing any unit.

name: High Tide
text: This tile will become Water at the start of the enemy turn.

name: Ice Storm
text: The storm causes anything present to become Frozen.

name: Lava Flow
text: The tile here will turn into Lava.

name: Lightning Strike
text: Lightning will strike here, killing any unit.

name: Seismic Activity
text: This tile will become a Chasm at the start of the enemy turn.

name: Tentacles
text: The unit here will die and the tile will turn into Lava.

name: Volcanic Projectile
text: A fireball will strike here, destroying anything present.
